name: WeatherX
author: gdeyoung
description: Extended weather: current temperature in the bar, enlarged tabbed dropdown — [Here] follows this device, pinned places, [+] adds any city via geocoding. Open-Meteo data: details grid with level bars, AQI, remaining-hours strip starting NOW, 7-day forecast, sun times, and a live keyless radar map (Esri basemap + RainViewer). No API key.

barWidget.description: Bar temp + tabbed weather dropdown (here + pinned places, details, hourly, 7-day, sun, radar)

schema.label: Bar label next to the icon (right click cycles): temperature, temperature + condition, or icon only
Pinned tabs (JSON array of {name, lat, lon}; the [+] button in the panel manages these)
